title: I Taught Maven to Be an Introvert
excerpt: A small Bash wrapper cut successful Maven output by more than 99.7% while preserving useful diagnostics for coding agents.
content_html:
How a small Bash wrapper reduced successful Maven output by more than 99.7% while preserving useful diagnostics for coding agents.

Maven is excellent at building Java projects.

It is also extremely talkative.

That verbosity is usually harmless when a developer is reading a terminal. For a coding agent, however, several thousand bytes of routine build output can displace source code, instructions, and the actual failure from the model’s working context.

So I built mvn-lite: a small, deterministic Bash wrapper that keeps successful Maven runs to one line and extracts only bounded, actionable evidence from failures.

I call it Introverted Maven.

Vanilla Maven████████████████████████████████6,753 bytes

mvn-lite▏16 bytes

More than 99.7% less output

In a real four-module Java application, successful output fell from 6,753 bytes to 16 bytes, and an invalid lifecycle failure fell from 2,730 bytes to 228 bytes. Maven’s exit status was preserved, complete failure logs were retained, and Maven arguments were not echoed in compact failure output.

Full measurements and methodology are available in the compatibility experiment report.

The goal is not to replace Maven’s diagnostics. It is to keep them from consuming an agent’s context unless they are needed.

The problem with ordinary Maven output

A routine Maven test run can produce dozens or hundreds of lines covering routine details such as:

  • reactor ordering
  • plugin execution
  • compiler phases
  • test totals

Most of this is useful when investigating a build, but almost none is useful when it succeeds.

A coding agent usually needs to know only:

PASS · 4.240 s

If the build fails, the agent needs a compact answer to a different question:

What is the next actionable thing I should inspect or fix?

A compact test failure might look like:

FAIL
Failure summary:
  Test: com.example.AppTest.shouldRejectInvalidInput
  Exception: java.lang.AssertionError: expected 400

Full Maven log:
  /project/.agent-logs/maven/maven-20260730-100000-12345.log

Re-run with --full for complete live output.

The raw Maven output still matters. It simply does not need to occupy the main conversation by default.

Maven’s -q option is too blunt for this use case: it suppresses output before the wrapper can inspect it. mvn-lite captures normal Maven output privately, so it can still surface failing tests, compiler errors, unresolved dependencies, failed goals, and immediate causes when a build fails.

What mvn-lite does

In compact mode, mvn-lite prefers the project’s executable ./mvnw, then falls back to mvn from PATH. It adds batch mode and disables transfer progress and color when equivalent options were not already supplied, then:

  1. captures complete output locally;
  2. preserves Maven’s exit status;
  3. prints a one-line success or bounded failure summary;
  4. retains failed logs and points to the complete log;
  5. falls back to a bounded tail for unknown failures.

Successful logs are deleted by default but can be preserved with --keep-log. Ordinary Maven output remains available through --full.

mvn-lite targets common local workflows: build, test, package, install, and verify. It recognizes high-value categories including compiler, test, dependency-resolution, failed-goal, and common Maven command errors.

Unknown output receives a bounded log tail rather than an invented interpretation, and the raw log remains authoritative.

Testing it in a real application

I tested mvn-lite in a real four-module Maven application. The selected module ran 102 unit tests using Maven 3.9.16 and the system-provided Bash 3.2 on macOS. The comparison covered vanilla Maven, the application’s former project-specific low-noise helper, and mvn-lite.

Bytes from stdout and stderr were the primary metric because they are exact and tokenizer-independent. Estimated tokens use ceil(output bytes / 4) for relative comparison, not as an exact model-token or billing measurement.

Successful build results

The successful run selected one module and ran its tests:

./mvnw -B -ntp -Dstyle.color=never -pl common test
RunnerBytesLinesEstimated tokens
Vanilla Maven6,75390~1,689
Former project-specific helper181~5
mvn-lite161~4

mvn-lite produced PASS · 3.944 s, reducing successful agent-visible output by more than 99.7%. It effectively matched the former helper; the two-byte difference is operationally meaningless.

As an additional real-world check, I also ran mvn-lite against the Scriptella reactor under JDK 17. The normal Maven run produced hundreds of lines, while mvn-lite completed with a single PASS · 11.137 s line. See the Scriptella smoke test.

Failure results

The initial failure experiment invoked an invalid Maven lifecycle phase:

./mvnw definitely-not-a-maven-phase

The first mvn-lite version was smaller than vanilla Maven and the former helper, but it repeated Maven’s complete list of valid lifecycle phases. The actionable information was only:

Maven: Unknown lifecycle phase "definitely-not-a-maven-phase"

I updated the parser to shorten recognized Maven command errors while preserving the complete original message in the raw log.

Actionable failure output after parser improvement

Agent-visible UTF-8 bytes, stdout + stderr

Vanilla Maven2,730

Former project-specific helper1,393

Original mvn-lite873

Targeted parser improvement

Updated mvn-lite228

73.9% less output than the original mvn-lite

The updated wrapper reduced output by 91.6% relative to vanilla Maven, 83.6% relative to the former project-specific helper, and 73.9% relative to the first mvn-lite implementation. It still preserved Maven’s exit status, the invalid phase, the complete-log location, and rerun guidance.

Extracting the immediate cause

Some Maven plugin failures include the useful cause on the same line as the failed goal:

Failed to execute goal org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-surefire-plugin:3.2.5:test
(default-test) on project app:
Execution default-test failed:
Unable to create temporary directory

A useful compact summary needs both:

Goal: org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-surefire-plugin:3.2.5:test (default-test)
Cause: Unable to create temporary directory

mvn-lite extracts at most one immediate cause from bounded forms such as:

Execution ... failed: <cause>

It does not reconstruct arbitrary exception chains or stack traces.

During the final application integration, a restricted workspace prevented Surefire from creating its normal target/surefire directory. The installed wrapper preserved exit status 1, retained the complete log, identified the Surefire goal, surfaced Unable to create temporary directory, and remained bounded.

The same build passed after normal filesystem permissions were restored.

Try mvn-lite in your project

To try the latest version:

curl -fsSL \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ejboy/agent-scripts/main/scripts/mvn-lite \
  -o mvn-lite
chmod +x mvn-lite

Review the script before running it in a sensitive repository. For a reproducible vendored copy, replace main with a release tag such as v0.1.0.

Arguments pass through to Maven. Use --full when ordinary Maven output is needed:

./mvn-lite test
./mvn-lite -pl common test
./mvn-lite --full test
./mvn-lite --help-mvn-lite

Why not summarize the logs with an LLM?

mvn-lite extracts the useful signal locally instead of spending agent tokens on an LLM summary or sending repository logs outside the environment. It requires no API key and falls back to a bounded log tail instead of making a probabilistic guess.

Limitations

This was a focused compatibility and adoption experiment: one real multi-module application, one successful module build, one synthetic lifecycle error, one real Surefire environmental failure, warm incremental state, and single measured runs.

This article summarizes the main findings. The complete experiment report contains the full environment, controls, intermediate results, checksums, and supporting evidence.

The results do not establish a fixed savings percentage, diagnostic parity for every Maven plugin or failure category, or that Maven itself runs faster.

The claim is narrower:

For the measured local-development scenarios, mvn-lite dramatically reduced agent-visible output while preserving the exit status, actionable failure evidence, and access to the complete raw log.

The broader lesson

Coding agents change the economics of command-line output.

Traditional build tools assume that console output is cheap. A developer can scroll, search, collapse, or ignore it.

For an agent, output competes directly with source code, requirements, conversation history, repository context, and the actual diagnostic. A tool designed for agent workflows should:

  1. Make success extremely small.
  2. Preserve exit status and actionable failure evidence.
  3. Retain complete diagnostics outside the main context.
  4. Bound unknown-output fallbacks and avoid echoing sensitive arguments.
  5. Preserve an escape hatch to ordinary output.

That is what mvn-lite is trying to do.

Maven still knows everything it knew before.

It has simply learned when not to say it.

Try mvn-lite in an existing Maven project. Real-world failure cases and feedback are especially useful.

⭐ Star on GitHub

content_html_zh:
小型 Bash 包装器如何将成功的 Maven 输出减少 99.7% 以上，同时保留编码代理的有用诊断信息。

Maven 非常擅长构建 Java 项目。

它也非常健谈。

当开发人员阅读终端时，这种冗长通常是无害的。 然而，对于编码代理来说，数千字节的例程构建输出可能会取代模型工作上下文中的源代码、指令和实际故障。

因此，我构建了 mvn-lite：一个小型的、确定性的 Bash 包装器，它将成功的 Maven 运行保持在一行，并仅从失败中提取有限的、可操作的证据。

我称之为内向的内向者。

Vanilla Maven████████████████████████████████6,753 字节

mvn-lite▏16 字节

产量减少 99.7% 以上

在真实的四模块 Java 应用程序中，成功输出从 6,753 字节减少到 16 字节，无效生命周期失败从 2,730 字节减少到 228 字节。 Maven 的退出状态被保留，完整的失败日志被保留，并且 Maven 参数没有在紧凑的失败输出中回显。

兼容性实验报告中提供了完整的测量结果和方法。

目标不是取代 Maven 的诊断功能。 这是为了防止它们消耗代理的上下文，除非需要它们。

普通Maven输出的问题

例行 Maven 测试运行可以生成数十行或数百行，涵盖例行细节，例如：

  • 反应堆排序
  • 插件执行
  • 编译阶段
  • 测试总数

其中大部分在调查构建时很有用，但在成功时几乎没有任何用处。

编码代理通常只需要知道：

PASS · 4.240 s

如果构建失败，代理需要对另一个问题的紧凑答案：

我应该检查或修复的下一个可操作的事情是什么？

紧凑的测试失败可能如下所示：

FAIL
Failure summary:
  Test: com.example.AppTest.shouldRejectInvalidInput
  Exception: java.lang.AssertionError: expected 400

Full Maven log:
  /project/.agent-logs/maven/maven-20260730-100000-12345.log

Re-run with --full for complete live output.

原始 Maven 输出仍然很重要。 它根本不需要默认占据主要对话。

对于这个用例来说，Maven 的 -q 选项太生硬了：它会在包装器检查输出之前抑制输出。 mvn-lite 私下捕获正常的 Maven 输出，因此它仍然可以显示失败的测试、编译器错误、未解决的依赖项、失败的目标以及构建失败时的直接原因。

mvn-lite 是做什么的

在紧凑模式下，mvn-lite 更喜欢项目的可执行文件 ./mvnw，然后从 PATH 回退到 mvn。 当尚未提供等效选项时，它添加批处理模式并禁用传输进度和颜色，然后：

  1. 在本地捕获完整的输出；
  2. 保留 Maven 的退出状态；
  3. 打印一行成功或有限失败摘要；
  4. 保留失败的日志并指向完整的日志；
  5. 对于未知的故障，回落到有界尾部。

成功的日志默认会被删除，但可以使用 --keep-log 保留。 普通 Maven 输出仍然可以通过 --full 获得。

mvn-lite 针对常见的本地工作流程：构建、测试、打包、安装和验证。 它可识别高价值类别，包括编译器、测试、依赖项解析、失败目标和常见 Maven 命令错误。

未知的输出接收有界日志尾部而不是发明的解释，并且原始日志仍然具有权威性。

在实际应用中测试它

我在一个真正的四模块 Maven 应用程序中测试了 mvn-lite。 所选模块使用 Maven 3.9.16 和系统提供的 Bash 3.2 在 macOS 上运行了 102 个单元测试。 比较涵盖了 vanilla Maven（该应用程序以前的特定于项目的低噪音助手）和 mvn-lite。

来自 stdout 和 stderr 的字节是主要指标，因为它们是精确的并且独立于标记器。 估计的令牌使用 ceil(输出字节/4) 进行相对比较，而不是作为精确的模型令牌或计费测量。

成功的构建结果

成功运行选择了一个模块并运行其测试：

./mvnw -B -ntp -Dstyle.color=never -pl common test
跑步者BytesLines估计代币
香草内文6,75390~1,689
前项目特定助手181~5
mvn 精简版161~4

mvn-lite 生成 PASS·3.944 s，将成功的代理可见输出减少了 99.7% 以上。 有效匹配了前帮手；两个字节的差异在操作上没有意义。

作为额外的实际检查，我还在 JDK 17 下针对 Scriptella 反应器运行了 mvn-lite。 正常的 Maven 运行产生了数百行，而 mvn-lite 仅用了一条 PASS · 11.137 s 行完成。 请参阅 Scriptella 烟雾测试。

失败结果

初始失败实验调用了无效的 Maven 生命周期阶段：

./mvnw definitely-not-a-maven-phase

第一个 mvn-lite 版本比 vanilla Maven 和以前的助手小，但它重复了 Maven 有效生命周期阶段的完整列表。 可操作的信息只有：

Maven: Unknown lifecycle phase "definitely-not-a-maven-phase"

我更新了解析器以缩短已识别的 Maven 命令错误，同时在原始日志中保留完整的原始消息。

解析器改进后可操作的失败输出

代理可见的 UTF-8 字节，stdout + stderr

香草 Maven2,730

前项目特定助手1,393

原来的mvn-lite873

有针对性的解析器改进

更新了 mvn-lite228

比原来的 mvn-lite 输出减少 73.9%

更新后的包装器相对于普通 Maven 减少了 91.6% 的输出，相对于之前的项目特定帮助器减少了 83.6%，相对于第一个 mvn-lite 实现减少了 73.9%。 它仍然保留 Maven 的退出状态、无效阶段、完整日志位置和重新运行指导。

提取直接原因

一些 Maven 插件失败包括与失败目标位于同一行的有用原因：

Failed to execute goal org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-surefire-plugin:3.2.5:test
(default-test) on project app:
Execution default-test failed:
Unable to create temporary directory

一个有用的紧凑摘要需要：

Goal: org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-surefire-plugin:3.2.5:test (default-test)
Cause: Unable to create temporary directory

mvn-lite 从有界形式中最多提取一个直接原因，例如：

Execution ... failed: <cause>

它不会重建任意异常链或堆栈跟踪。

在最终的应用程序集成期间，受限工作空间阻止 Surefire 创建其正常的 target/surefire 目录。 安装的包装器保留退出状态 1，保留完整日志，识别 Surefire 目标，出现无法创建临时目录，并保持受限制。

恢复正常文件系统权限后，相同的构建也通过了。

在您的项目中尝试 mvn-lite

要尝试最新版本：

curl -fsSL \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ejboy/agent-scripts/main/scripts/mvn-lite \
  -o mvn-lite
chmod +x mvn-lite

在敏感存储库中运行脚本之前先检查该脚本。 对于可复制的供应商副本，请将 main 替换为发布标签，例如 v0.1.0。

参数传递给 Maven。 当需要普通 Maven 输出时使用 --full：

./mvn-lite test
./mvn-lite -pl common test
./mvn-lite --full test
./mvn-lite --help-mvn-lite

为什么不用法学硕士来总结日志呢？

mvn-lite 在本地提取有用的信号，而不是在 LLM 摘要上花费代理令牌或将存储库日志发送到环境之外。 它不需要 API 密钥，并且会退回到有界日志尾部，而不是进行概率猜测。

局限性

这是一项重点突出的兼容性和采用实验：一个真实的多模块应用程序、一个成功的模块构建、一个综合生命周期错误、一个真实的 Surefire 环境故障、热增量状态和单次测量运行。

本文总结了主要发现。 完整的实验报告包含完整的环境、控制、中间结果、校验和和支持证据。

结果并没有建立固定的节省百分比、每个 Maven 插件或故障类别的诊断奇偶校验，或者 Maven 本身运行得更快。

索赔范围更窄：

对于测量的本地开发场景，mvn-lite 显着减少了代理可见的输出，同时保留退出状态、可操作的故障证据以及对完整原始日志的访问。

更广泛的教训

编码代理改变了命令行输出的经济性。

传统的构建工具假设控制台输出是廉价的。 开发人员可以滚动、搜索、折叠或忽略它。

对于代理来说，输出直接与源代码、需求、对话历史记录、存储库上下文和实际诊断竞争。 专为代理工作流程设计的工具应该：

  1. 让成功变得极其渺小。
  2. 保留退出状态和可操作的故障证据。
  3. 在主要上下文之外保留完整的诊断。
  4. 绑定未知输出回退并避免回显敏感参数。
  5. 保留普通输出的逃生舱口。

这就是 mvn-lite 正在尝试做的事情。

Maven 仍然知道它以前知道的一切。

它只是学会了何时不该说出来。

在现有的 Maven 项目中尝试 mvn-lite。 现实世界的失败案例和反馈特别有用。
